diagnosis: Diagnostic reuse=off (since removed) showed gables narrowphase 6.62 ms without reuse vs ~8.4 ms with it: the reuse path's serial history lookups (per-probe previous-contact loads to compare colliders, generation load, count loop over up to 8 previous contacts) cost more than full SAT+clipping.
change: hashInsert=record: the per-manifold insert writes 4-word slots in gConstraintIds (claim = previous manifold + 1, unique so weak-CAS ownership is unambiguous; collider A; collider B; run start | run length << 28). tryReuseContacts and persistence resolve the pair key and run from one slot line per probe, scanning to EMPTY and keeping the minimum start (the per-contact hash's minimum-head merge). Run length comes from the manifold block (every point of a live manifold is alive). Exhaustion raises OVERFLOW_WARM_HASH (256). Slots = nextPow2(max(prevContacts/2, 4*bodies, 1024)) capped at the pre-CSR region / 4.
sizingBug: Sizing slots from the CPU contact count alone gave 262144 slots during the first bench batch (contact seed = 4*bodies) for ~230k manifolds; probes exhausted, warm starts dropped and the bench workload diverged (1,183,098 vs 1,184,245). The body floor fixed it; check mode (frequent readbacks) was already identical.
